audit.why: EVEN 5.5/10 fits WR 50.59 over 680 games: Taliyah owns the lane phases, Galio's teamfight/global-ult scaling keeps the game even.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer level chart is blanket 'Skill' on all rows; packet levelChart and content win[] agree on Taliyah rows 0-5 and Skill at 2+ items.
audit.why: Kit-grounded: Galio's only engage is Justice Punch (11s CD dash your E mines stun), his taunt needs a stationary charge, his ult is a roam tool — Taliyah wins every lane stage; late-game teamfight taunt plus global ult makes 2+ items execution-dependent.
audit.corrected: Full sides 0-5 -> Taliyah with rewritten whys; row 6 left Skill.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0].text claims Galio 'has no gap-close until his ult' and whys[2] says 'zero mobility' — Justice Punch (E) is a 650-range dash, the matchup's defining ability per the full layer itself. breakdown.cooldowns had no digits; the Colossal Smash auto-reset tell (missingInteractions) was absent.
audit.why: Kit: Justice Punch 11/10/9/8/7s dash-knockup — a dash, so Taliyah's E mines stun it and W knock-through detonates; Shield of Durand 18s with charge-up; Winds of War 11-7s at 60-80 mana; Colossal Smash is an auto-reset burst tell.
audit.corrected: spikes[0] and whys[2]/[3] rewritten; numbers in cooldowns; reset tell in dontsFull[2].d.

edits.after: Taliyah

edits.before: Q on fresh ground shreds level-1 trades — most mids don't expect five stones at minute two. Manage your Worked Ground like mana.
edits.after: You win level 1 — Galio is slow and mana-hungry, and your 1000-range Q out-pokes his telegraphed 825-range Winds of War gusts.

edits.before: Skill
edits.after: Taliyah

edits.before: W online: the shove-displacement already threatens kill angles against overstep-happy laners.
edits.after: W online: keep harassing him off the wave while he burns 60+ mana per tornado answering back.

edits.before: Skill
edits.after: Taliyah

edits.before: Full kit: W-into-E is the signature burst — shove him across the stones and watch half a health bar disappear.
edits.after: Full kit: his Justice Punch is a dash — seed E across his engage lane and the knockup attempt eats your stun instead.

edits.before: Skill
edits.after: Taliyah

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — Q-poke on every wave contact. Fresh-ground positioning is your real skill expression now.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 yours — his taunt needs a stationary charge and Justice Punch is an 11s cooldown; trade into its downtime.

edits.before: Skill
edits.after: Taliyah

edits.before: Weaver's Wall online — you are now the best roaming mid in the game. Every shove is a bot-lane gank announcement.
edits.after: At 6 Hero's Entrance is a roam button, not a duel answer — match the fly-out: crash and wall-surf to the same fight.

edits.before: Skill
edits.after: Taliyah

edits.before: Luden's spike: the W-E-Q rotation deletes squishies. Force river fights where your stones pre-seed the geometry.
edits.after: Luden's keeps you ahead — out-poke his mana-starved clear and force trades whenever Winds of War is down (7-11s).

edits.before: Level 3 gives you the W-E combo to punish his zero mobility.
edits.after: Level 3 gives you W-E — his only dash detonates your mines.

edits.before: Through levels 4-5 you dominate trades since he must charge his taunt and can't chase you.
edits.after: Through levels 4-5 you dominate trades since his taunt needs a charge and his E is 11s down.

edits.before: You control this window: Galio is a slow, mana-hungry laner who relies on landing Winds of War (Q) tornadoes, and he has no gap-close until his ult. Poke him with Q on worked ground, sidestep his Q gusts, and when he steps up W him into your E field for a displacement detonation before his Shield of Durand can charge.
edits.after: You control this window: Galio is slow and mana-hungry and relies on landing Winds of War (Q); his one gap-close is Justice Punch (E), a dash your minefield stuns. Poke with Q on worked ground, sidestep the gusts, and when he punches in W him back through your E field before Shield of Durand can charge.

edits.before: Levels 3-6 stay yours because your W-E combo punishes his lack of mobility and his charge-up Shield of Durand, and his level-6 Hero's Entrance is a roam tool rather than a lane duel button.
edits.after: Levels 3-6 stay yours because your W-E combo punishes his single telegraphed dash and his charge-up Shield of Durand, and his level-6 Hero's Entrance is a roam tool rather than a duel button.

edits.before: - Galio Justice Punch: matchup-defining — His dash knockup — he has no engage while it is down. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your W Seismic Shove like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Galio Justice Punch: matchup-defining — 11s at rank 1, 7s max, and his only engage: while it is down he cannot reach you. - His W taunt is an 18s cooldown plus a charge. - Guard your W Seismic Shove like a fifth summoner spell.

edits.before: Q from fresh ground on his last-hit, and if he steps to answer, W-shove him across the E-field — the full geometry trade is half a health bar.
edits.after: Justice Punch stops on the first champion hit — W him back through your E mid-dash and his own engage detonates the stun before the knockup lands.

edits.before: Trading while standing on your own Worked Ground — one-stone Qs lose every exchange your positioning already conceded.
edits.after: His Colossal Smash auto-reset and taunt win long brawls — burst on your terms and step out before the shield charge finishes.

edits.before: Flash + Teleport or Ignite — TP doubles the roam thesis; Ignite converts the W-E burst into early deletions. Pick by how hard you intend to roam.
edits.after: Flash + Teleport or Ignite — TP extends the roam plan across resets; Ignite converts the W-E burst into early deletions. Pick by how hard you intend to roam.

notes: Full sides 0-5 aligned to packet and content (they agree; no win[] edits — chart rule case 2); row 6 Skill on all layers, left alone. Suspect name 'Hero's Entrance' is the real R name — false positive. Galio is male. Note: 'W-shove him INTO your E' wording kept where present (knock-through detonates mines per Taliyah E text).
